_about: Head coaches tab data, built once by updater/coaches/build.py from coaches/curated.json and the official NBL box scores (nblR files): each NBL27 head coach's NBL head-coaching seasons since 2015-16 - regular-season games he coached, his team's ratings and four factors in those games, their rank among that season's teams (1 = best; pace: 1 = fastest) and the league average - and his whole head-coaching career in every league ('career', newest first, with the pages read in 'csrc'; NBL rows from 2015-16 checked against the official results) and national-team jobs; 'seasons' also carries his full seasons in other leagues ('league'), from every team's totals in coaches/overseas_teams.json. Built 2026-10-27.

recordSource.name: Wikipedia, NBL All-Time Coaching Records (to the end of 2025-26)
